text:
anya: Quick design question — for the trace/request-export CTA, should the default filename include the correlation_id? Thinking of enterprise customers who search by corr-id vs. privacy (PII leaking in filenames). thomas: leaning toward including it but behind a toggle. default = anonymized (timestamp + service) and let power users opt in. customers in finance/reg have requested no id in filenames. :thinking_face: liam: from runtime side, including corr-id is cheap; we already stitch it. downside is some storage / S3 index pollution if teams blindly export lots. also need to avoid any raw header values with user ids. nora: agree with toggle. suggest default filename pattern `redwood-trace--.json` and an optional `+corr-` when user checks "Include correlation id". also add tooltip: "Including correlation IDs helps debugging but may include identifiers tied to requests." anya: UI notes: - primary CTA stays "Download trace" - small secondary menu arrow -> "Export options" that opens modal w/ toggles: [Include correlation id] [Anonymize IPs] [Format: JSON/CSV] - microcopy for the toggle: "Include correlation ID (helps link logs across systems)" — need concise line and a11y label. thomas: perf question — CSV export for large traces? should we warn about size? liam: yes. CSV is lossy for nested spans, but ok if we flatten. backend can stream and gz. we should show file size estimate before download. show a spinner + cancel. anya: accessibility nits: focus should move into modal when opened, escape closes, and the export menu should be reachable via keyboard from the trace header (kbd: Enter/Space on the chevron). Also toggle states need clear aria-pressed/aria-checked labels. nora: adding to that — if we include correlation id toggle, aria-describedby should point to the tooltip explaining privacy implications. Provide `role="status"` for the size estimate when it updates so screen readers announce it. liam: sample aria snippet I can add to frontend: ```

Including correlation IDs helps link logs across systems but may contain identifiers.

``` anya: perfect. copy suggestions: CTA in modal should be "Download" not "Export" (less technical). small help text under filename input: "Filenames will be sanitized to remove user-identifying tokens unless you opt in." thomas: one more product thing — allow a permalink option that creates an obfuscated download key (so we can give a link that doesn't expose corr-id but still references the trace). We can reuse existing signed-url flow. nora: yep we can emit a short token and map on server side. token payload should exclude headers flagged as PII by default. we should also add an audit-log entry when a user downloads a trace containing corr-ids (for enterprise compliance). liam: implementation note — for `Include correlation ID` we'll add a server-side scrub step controlled by a flag. default false for orgs with compliance toggle on. also include rate-limit checks for bulk exports. anya: visual polish requests: - filename input left-aligned with export toggle stacked under it - small copy pill showing pattern example: `redwood-trace-orders-2026-04-12T14-02.json` - if corr-id included show `...+corr-abc123.json` in the pill (truncate middle) thomas: UX question — for keyboard users, should the pill be selectable text (so they can Cmd/Ctrl-C) or a copy button? anya: both: allow select-to-copy and add a tiny copy icon with `aria-label="Copy export filename"`. icon should be reachable via keyboard (tabindex=0). nora: security request — disallow any exported filename containing `.` or `..` segments or shell metacharacters. backend will sanitize. frontend should preview sanitized final name. liam: will add server-side sanitize rules and return final filename in response; UI will show a toast: "Filename sanitized to safe name: ". `role=status` for screen reader announcement. a11y-bot: Accessibility checklist (auto): - focus trap in modal: yes - ARIA labels on toggles: yes - status announcements for size/filename: yes - keyboard actionable copy icon: yes - color contrast for disabled toggle state: check contrast ratio >= 4.5:1 Please file a small a11y ticket if any of the above is skipped. :white_check_mark: anya: thanks — next steps: I'll mock the modal with the filename pill and the toggles, include the microcopy. @liam can you confirm server will return final sanitized filename and size estimate endpoint? @nora can you confirm audit log entry and signed-url permalinks? liam: yes — can have a small endpoint `/export/preview?trace_id=...&include_corr=true` returning `{final_name, est_bytes}` within a day. nora: signed-url and audit logs — okay from platform side. will add feature flag for org-level default (include_corr_default = false). thomas: awesome. schedule a 20m quick review once mock is in Figma? I can bring compliance notes. anya: thanks all — will ping when Figma mock is ready. :sparkles:
